data.title: Decoding Microsoft's AI workforce shake-up: Are more layoffs coming?
data.description: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi takes a closer look at Microsoft's (MSFT) employee buyouts on Sozzi Unleashed, examining the role of artificial intelligence in the tech giant's evolving workforce strategy. Sozzi breaks down what's driving the changes, how AI could reshape Microsoft's staffing needs, and whether another round of layoffs could be on the horizon.
